description: This file defines the SubPanelSearchForm class, which extends SearchForm to customize the display and behavior of search forms within subpanels in the SuiteCRM application. It manages subpanel-specific display details such as assigning subpanel IDs and handling collection lists.

classes.name: SubPanelSearchForm
classes.description: A subclass of SearchForm that adds specific handling for subpanel display in SuiteCRM, including managing subpanel IDs and collection lists.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SubPanelSearchForm with references to the subpanel object and sets up the parent SearchForm with seed, module, 'DetailView' view, and options.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and renders the subpanel search form, including assigning the subpanel ID and handling pagination offset in the search form variables.

methods.name: getCollectionList
methods.description: Returns a list of collection names based on the provided collection array, mapping module identifiers to their display names using the global app_list_strings.

methods.name: displaySavedSearchSelect
methods.description: Stub method that returns null, potentially overridden in subclasses or future implementations.
